title: OTHRYS OS local chat session shell
goal: Make New Chat and the composer functional as a controller-local draft/session surface without invoking models or creating execution authority.
laws: Chat session state is controller-local only.
Send stores a local draft message and performs no network/model request.
New Chat clears only the local controller session.
No /api/chat or model invocation endpoint is added.
Model selector remains a preference/preview surface only.
Mission authority and Work State are unchanged by chat drafts.
Existing Refine intent is the only bounded control write path.

slices.title: Wire New Chat and composer locally
